overview: Wart is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: From a clinical perspective, warts are non-cancerous viral growths usually occurring on the hands and feet but which can also affect other locations, such as the genitals or face.
From a clinical perspective, one or many warts may appear.
In routine practice, they are distinguished from cancerous tumors as they are caused by the human papillomavirus, rather than a cancer growth.
